carpet.rule.preventExtremeTntMomentum.na: Prevent extreme TNT initial momentum generation
carpet.rule.preventExtremeTntMomentum.de: Prevents TNT from generating initial momentum values that can cause collision issues
carpet.rule.tntInitialXVelocity.name: Set TNT initial X velocity
carpet.rule.tntInitialXVelocity.desc: Sets TNT initial X velocity component, -1 for vanilla
carpet.rule.disableAmethystWaterGrowth.n: Disable amethyst bud growth in water
carpet.rule.disableAmethystWaterGrowth.d: Prevents amethyst buds from growing into water
carpet.rule.waterWallLavaProtection.name: Water Wall Lava Protection
carpet.rule.waterWallLavaProtection.desc: Prevents lava from generating cobblestone/obsidian when a waterlogged stone stair (bottom face exposed) is present 1 or 2 blocks above.
carpet.rule.explosionRayInit.name: Set Explosion Ray Initial Value
carpet.rule.explosionRayInit.desc: Fixed multiplier for explosion ray initial strength. Range: 0 to 16 (vanilla default is a random value between 0.7 and 1.3). Set to any value outside this range to use vanilla behavior
